schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled.

This parameter is returned only when `PayType` is set to `Prepaid`
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
实例是否自动续费。返回值：
true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

仅当PayType取值为Prepaid（包年包月）时，此参数有返回值

BurstingEnabled.description_en:

true: Enabled

false: Disabled
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
是否已开启IO突发。返回值：

true：已开启
false：未开启

Category.description_en:
The instance category. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition

HighAvailability: High-availability Edition

Finance: Enterprise Edition

This parameter is returned only when the `InstanceLevel` parameter is set to `1`
Category.description_zh:
实例系列。返回值：
Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
Finance：三节点企业系列
仅在InstanceLevel参数为1时返回

The connection mode of the instance. Valid values:

Safe: database proxy mode
ConnectionMode.description_zh:
实例的访问模式。返回值：

Safe：数据库代理模式

true

false

实例是否属于[MySQL DuckDB分析实例]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2950002.html）。返回值：

true：是
false：否

LockMode.description_en:
The lock state of the instance. Valid values:

Unlock: The instance is not locked.

ManualLock: The instance is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The instance is automatically locked due to expiration.

LockByRestoration: The instance is automatically locked before a rollback.

LockByDiskQuota: The instance is automatically locked because its storage is full.

Released: The instance is released. After an instance is released, it cannot be unlocked. You can only restore the data of the instance to a new instance
LockMode.description_zh:
实例的锁定状态。返回值：

Unlock：正常。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定。
Released：实例已释放。此时实例无法进行解锁，只能使用备份数据重新创建新实例，重建时间较长，请耐心等待

LockReason.description_en: The reason why the instance was locked

MasterInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the primary instance. If this parameter is null, the instance is a primary instance
MasterInstanceId.description_zh: 主实例的ID，如果没有返回此参数（即为null）则表示该实例是主实例

Indicates whether the instance is deployed in multiple zones. Valid values:

true

false

A multiple-zone deployment is a deployment in which the zone ID contains MAZ. For example, the zone ID is `cn-hangzhou-MAZ10(h,i)`
MutriORsignle.description_zh:
是否是组合可用区。返回值：
true
false
组合可用区即带有MAZ字样的可用区。例如：`cn-hangzhou-MAZ10(h,i)`

items.description_en: The details of a read-only instance

100: Supported

0: Not supported

当前专属集群MySQL通用版实例是否支持高可用权重切换。返回值：

页码。
